extensionDescription.message: Montre quand vos requêtes passent par un intermédiaire qui les déchiffre, comme Cloudflare, Akamai ou Imperva.
extensionDescription.description: Description of the extension, shown in the add-ons manager.

titleNeutral.message: Aucune requête vue dans cet onglet ne passe par un intermédiaire connu.
titleNeutral.description: Tooltip of the toolbar icon when no request seen in the tab goes through a known provider.

titleNotObserved.message: Site non observé : l'accès à ce site a été retiré à l'extension, elle ne peut rien en dire.
titleNotObserved.description: Tooltip of the toolbar icon when the extension has no access to the site of the tab and saw nothing.

titleIgnored.description: Tooltip of the toolbar icon when the user asked the extension to ignore the site of the tab.

countLevel2One.description: Line of the tooltip that counts the requests of the tab at level 2, blue, when there is one.

countLevel2Many.description: Line of the tooltip that counts the requests of the tab at level 2, blue, when there are several.

countLevel3ProvenOne.description: Line of the tooltip that counts the requests of the tab at level 3, red, when there is one.

countLevel3ProvenMany.description: Line of the tooltip that counts the requests of the tab at level 3, red, when there are several.

countLevel3UnprovenOne.message: Niveau 3, lecture : 1 requête, déchiffrement non prouvé
countLevel3UnprovenOne.description: Line of the tooltip that counts the requests of the tab at level 3, orange, when there is one.

countLevel3UnprovenMany.message: Niveau 3, lecture : $COUNT$ requêtes, déchiffrement non prouvé
countLevel3UnprovenMany.description: Line of the tooltip that counts the requests of the tab at level 3, orange, when there are several.

countLevel4ProvenOne.message: Niveau 4, données personnelles : 1 requête, déchiffrement prouvé
countLevel4ProvenOne.description: Line of the tooltip that counts the requests of the tab at level 4, red, when there is one.

countLevel4ProvenMany.message: Niveau 4, données personnelles : $COUNT$ requêtes, déchiffrement prouvé
countLevel4ProvenMany.description: Line of the tooltip that counts the requests of the tab at level 4, red, when there are several.

countLevel4UnprovenOne.message: Niveau 4, données personnelles : 1 requête, déchiffrement non prouvé
countLevel4UnprovenOne.description: Line of the tooltip that counts the requests of the tab at level 4, orange, when there is one.

countLevel4UnprovenMany.message: Niveau 4, données personnelles : $COUNT$ requêtes, déchiffrement non prouvé
countLevel4UnprovenMany.description: Line of the tooltip that counts the requests of the tab at level 4, orange, when there are several.

titleBlue.message: $PROVIDER$ sert des ressources publiques de cette page : il sait que vous la visitez, et quand.
titleBlue.description: Line of the tooltip that says what the provider of the most serious request of the tab sees: blue, levels 1 and 2.

titleOrange.message: Cette page passe par $PROVIDER$, qui voit peut-être en clair tout ce qu'elle échange avec le site.
titleOrange.description: Line of the tooltip that says what the provider of the most serious request of the tab sees: orange, levels 3 and 4, decryption not proven.

titleRed.message: $PROVIDER$ voit en clair tout ce que cette page échange avec le site : adresses, pages, cookies et formulaires.
titleRed.description: Line of the tooltip that says what the provider of the most serious request of the tab sees: red, levels 3 and 4, decryption proven.

titleSessionProven.message: Des cookies ou un jeton de connexion en font partie, ils peuvent suffire à ouvrir votre compte.
titleSessionProven.description: Line added to the tooltip when the tab saw a request through a provider that carries a cookie of the site or an Authorization header, and the decryption of one such request was proven.

titleSessionUnproven.message: Des cookies ou un jeton de connexion en feraient partie, ils pourraient suffire à ouvrir votre compte.
titleSessionUnproven.description: Line added to the tooltip when the tab saw a request through a provider that carries a cookie of the site or an Authorization header, and the decryption of none was proven.

titleAntiBotProven.message: Une partie de ces échanges vient de sa protection anti-robot.
titleAntiBotProven.description: Line added to the tooltip when the tab saw a request of the anti-bot machinery of a provider, and the decryption of one such request was proven. "Its" is the provider named in the line before.

titleAntiBotUnproven.message: Une partie de ces échanges viendrait de sa protection anti-robot.
titleAntiBotUnproven.description: Line added to the tooltip when the tab saw a request of the anti-bot machinery of a provider, and the decryption of none was proven. "Its" is the provider named in the line before.

titlePartial.message: Vue partielle : l'extension n'a pas accès à tous les sites, elle ne montre que ce qu'elle a vu.
titlePartial.description: Line added to the tooltip when the extension lacks the access to all sites.

titleMissed.message: Vue partielle : l'extension n'a pas pu voir toutes les requêtes de cette page.
titleMissed.description: Line added to the tooltip when the extension got the response of a request whose sending it never saw, or started after the page did.

popupPage.description: Title of the popup section that shows the counts of the displayed page.

popupUnit.description: Unit at the right of a popup section title whose rows count requests.

popupSite.description: Title of the popup section that shows the kept counts of the site, with the date they started: when the site was last cleared, or when the extension started counting for a site never cleared.

popupSitePrivate.description: Title of the popup section that shows the counts of the site in a private window, which live only for the private session.

popupBrowserPage.description: Shown in place of the site name in the popup when the tab shows a page of the browser, reader view included.

popupUnknownSite.description: Shown in place of the site name in the popup when the tab shows a website whose site the extension does not know.

popupNothingBrowser.message: Aucun site n'est affiché, il n'y a rien à compter.
popupNothingBrowser.description: Popup notice for a page of the browser, which has no site to count, shown only when the popup shows nothing else of the page.

popupNothingSite.message: Aucune requête vue sur ce site n'est passée par un intermédiaire connu.
popupNothingSite.description: Popup notice under the site title when no request of the site went through a known provider.

popupIgnoreSite.description: Popup button that asks to ignore the site shown from now on, which erases its counts. Hidden when the popup shows no site, in a private window, so that no site visited in private enters the list of ignored sites kept on disk, and for a site already ignored.

popupUnignoreSite.description: Popup button that watches the ignored site shown again, at once and without a question, since nothing is lost. Shown only for an ignored site, in a private window too.

popupClearSite.description: Popup button that asks to clear the counts of the site shown and of no other site: its kept counts, or in a private window its counts of the private session. Hidden when the popup shows no site, and for an ignored site, which keeps no count.

popupIgnore.description: Popup button that confirms ignoring the site the popup shows, which erases its counts.

popupClear.description: Popup button that confirms the clearing of the counts of the site the popup shows.

popupCancel.description: Popup button that gives up the clearing of the counts of the site the popup shows, or ignoring it.

popupIgnoreSiteQuestion.description: Question the popup asks before it ignores the site shown, with the site as the popup header shows it. Ignoring a site erases its counts.

popupClearSiteQuestion.message: Effacer les comptes de $SITE$ gardés depuis le $DATE$ ?
popupClearSiteQuestion.description: Question the popup asks before it clears the kept counts of the site shown, and of no other site, with the site as the popup header shows it and the date its counts started.

popupClearSiteQuestionPrivate.message: Effacer les comptes de $SITE$ dans cette session privée ?
popupClearSiteQuestionPrivate.description: Question the popup of a private window asks before it clears the counts of the site shown in the private session, and nothing of its kept counts nor of the other sites, with the site as the popup header shows it.

popupIgnored.description: Title the popup shows in place of the counts when the user asked to ignore the site shown.

popupIgnoredText.message: Cloud Leak ne regarde pas les requêtes de ce site et n'en compte aucune.
popupIgnoredText.description: Popup text under the title of an ignored site, which says why the popup shows no count.

popupWatchedAgain.message: Ce site est de nouveau regardé, à partir du prochain chargement de la page.
popupWatchedAgain.description: Popup text shown right after the user stopped ignoring the site shown: the page still open was not watched meanwhile.

popupPreferences.description: Accessible name and tooltip of the gear of the popup, which opens the preferences of the extension in the add-ons manager.

level1.description: Name of leak level 1 in a row of the popup.

level2.description: Name of leak level 2 in a row of the popup.

level3.description: Name of leak level 3 in a row of the popup.

level4.description: Name of leak level 4 in a row of the popup.

decryptionProven.description: Proof line under a red row of the popup.

decryptionUnproven.description: Proof line under an orange row of the popup.

optionsIgnoredSites.description: Title of the list of ignored sites, the first title of the preferences page.

optionsIgnoredText.message: Cloud Leak ne regarde pas les requêtes de ces sites et n'en compte aucune.
optionsIgnoredText.description: Text under the title of the list of ignored sites in the preferences.

optionsRemove.description: Button of each ignored site in the preferences, which watches the site again at once, without a question, since nothing is lost.

optionsRemoveSite.description: Accessible name of the button that removes an ignored site in the preferences, with the site as the list shows it.

optionsEmpty.message: Aucun site n'est ignoré. Ajoutez-en un ci-dessous, ou cliquez sur Ignorer dans la fenêtre de Cloud Leak.
optionsEmpty.description: Text of the preferences in place of the list when no site is ignored. "Ignore" is the button of the popup, the window the toolbar button opens.

optionsAddSite.description: Label of the field of the preferences where the user types a site to ignore.

optionsAdd.description: Button of the preferences that ignores the site the field names, which erases its counts, without a question.

optionsHelp.message: Un domaine ou une adresse, réduit à son site (www.twitch.tv donne twitch.tv). Ses comptes sont effacés.
optionsHelp.description: Help under the field of the preferences while nothing is typed: what to type, how it is reduced to its registrable domain, and that adding a site erases its counts.

optionsPreview.description: Line under the field of the preferences while the text typed names a site, followed by that site, in bold: what the Add button will ignore.

optionsRefused.message: Aucun site ne correspond à « $TEXT$ ». Saisissez un domaine, comme twitch.tv.
optionsRefused.description: Line under the field of the preferences when the text typed names no site, with that text: nothing is added.

optionsAlready.description: Line under the field of the preferences when the text typed names a site already in the list, with the site as the list shows it.
